_comment: The three Brokild collections, declared rather than inferred.
A collection is a DERIVED artefact: it goes stale the moment the fleet gains or
renames a plug-in, and it had done so twice before anyone noticed. So every
plug-in that ships a download must appear in exactly one collection's `includes`
or in `excludes`, and tools/check-links.js fails if it does not, if an archive on
disk disagrees with its list, or if a page's wording contradicts a count.
Adding a plug-in to the fleet therefore forces a decision about the collections
instead of leaving one to be remembered.
The split was agreed 2026-09-23; see REPO-CONSOLIDATION.md. The three match the
three folders install-fleet.ps1 already creates, so the site and the disk are

brokild.title: The Brokild Collection
brokild.blurb: The instruments and effects that are finished and meant to be used.
brokild._shapeNote: Every folder in this archive holds a plug-in, a standalone and a PDF. That promise is what makes the whole archive worth downloading, so the builder asserts it per plug-in and aborts rather than shipping a folder that is short.

experimental.title: The Experimental Collection
experimental.blurb: Instruments that exist to ask a question about how sound can be made. Each one is a thesis rather than a product.
experimental._shapeNote: The rule is relaxed here ON PURPOSE. A plug-in with a bundle and a README is an honest thing to find in this archive; holding it back until it has a standalone would mean never shipping the experiments at all.
experimental._framing: PURPOSE, NOT POLISH. Do not call these unfinished: Photo Synth carries the largest manual in the fleet at 38 pages, and Brain Scan and High Tide both ship full handbooks. What they are not is useful the way a compressor is useful, and that is the thing to say.

proxima.title: Proxima Centauri B — the findings
proxima.blurb: Four alien instruments recovered from one fiction, sharing a survey and a findings document but deliberately sharing no mechanisms.
proxima._shapeNote: The four ship from one folder and share one Field Findings PDF, so the archive is four bundles and one document rather than four of everything.
proxima._includesNote: These are the four zips inside vst3-apps/proxima-centauri-b, not folders of their own: the survey is the page they share.

claims._comment: The phrase the card already uses. Declared here so a change of membership forces the card to be rewritten, rather than imposing wording the page never chose.

excludes._comment: Ships a download, deliberately in no collection.
